anchors.claim: Coalescing requires a common address space in the stated protection model; other-domain pages may need migration.
Contiguous virtual and physical layout, alignment and shared address space; explicit migration of Application 2 before Application 1 coalescing.
En-masse allocation near kernel launch with known application; small/non-aligned allocations need not preserve contiguity; soft domain guarantee.
Free frame and per-application base-page lists; fully populated frame criterion.
PTE changes implement in-place coalescing without migrating the selected data.
Old small mappings remain usable because physical locations remain correct; does not prove arbitrary permission change safe.
Deallocation-triggered occupancy threshold, same-application same-channel migration, and emergency-frame reuse.
Splintering clears large-page status and flushes the large mapping before possible migration.
GPU simulation with multiple applications; results are not this proposal's NIC/IOMMU measurements.
Mosaic relates reservation-based allocation, Ingens utilization tracking and prior placement policies; no novelty inference from a new label.

sources.title: Coordinated and Efficient Huge Page Management with Ingens

anchors.claim: Uses utilization tracking, access-frequency tracking and contiguity monitoring for processes/VMs.
Defers splitting high-utilization huge pages after base-page free; splits and releases clear-bit pages after threshold crossing.
Fault path requests promotion; Promote-kth allocates/compacts asynchronously; proactive compaction is batched and avoids moving frequently accessed pages.
Access-frequency-aware sharing decisions and share/idle-based contiguity allocation.
Promotion may allocate a new contiguous region, copy the original pages, remap and free old storage.
Anonymous-memory and NUMA limits; access-bit scanning can invalidate TLB entries and impose overhead; CPU server evaluation.

limitations: Two-column extracted text; no new PDF rendering or page-anchor verification.
Utilization and access history are not final DMA-reference completion certificates.
No exact compaction trigger direction is claimed: the paper's method and evaluation prose need care if that detail becomes decisive.
Absence claim restricted to §§4–5 methods concerning destination-late DMA ownership transitions.
